D.

E.
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE OVERSIGHT BOARD
E-1
CONSIDERATION OF REFUNDING THE 2007 TAX ALLOCATION BONDS
It is recommended that the Oversight Board adopt a Resolution authorizing and directing the following:
1.
Commence the process of refunding the Prior Bonds of the former Community Development Commission in accordance with Health & Safety Codes Section 34177.5; and
2.
Authorize the Executive Director to execute and deliver any and all documents and agreements and all acts and things necessary or advisable for carrying out the transactions contemplated by this Resolution. Such actions by the Executive Director are hereby ratified, confirmed and approved.
